cta_subtitle: Start your free trial and get access to all features.

gestao_anuncios.title: Listing Management
gestao_anuncios.subtitle: Complete control of your listings, ADS campaigns, bids and advertising performance. Manage everything in a single integrated dashboard.

feature1.title: ADS Campaigns
feature1.description: View and manage all your Mercado Libre advertising campaigns, with cost, clicks, impressions and conversion metrics.

feature2.title: Bid Management
feature2.description: Adjust bids per product or ad group, with suggestions based on historical performance.

feature3.title: ACOS & ROAS Metrics
feature3.description: Track cost per sale (ACOS) and return on ad spend (ROAS) for each campaign.

feature4.title: Performance Alerts
feature4.description: Receive notifications when campaigns lose efficiency or advertised products run out of stock.

feature5.title: Listing Timeline
feature5.description: Visualize the lifecycle of your listings with sales history, gaps and health status.

feature6.title: Bulk Actions
feature6.description: Pause, reactivate or adjust multiple listings at once with the action center.

faq1.question: Do I need to connect my ADS account separately?
faq1.answer: No, when you connect your Mercado Libre account, advertising data is imported automatically.

faq2.question: Can I manage ADS for multiple accounts?
faq2.answer: Yes! You can view and manage campaigns from all your Mercado Libre accounts in one dashboard.

faq3.question: Are metrics updated in real time?
faq3.answer: Metrics are synced periodically with the official Mercado Libre API, ensuring always up-to-date data.

dashboard_analises.title: Dashboard & Analytics
dashboard_analises.subtitle: Complete panels with sales KPIs, revenue, average ticket and performance evolution. Make decisions based on real data.

feature1.title: Sales KPIs
feature1.description: Track sales, revenue, average ticket and order volume in real time.

feature2.title: Evolution Charts
feature2.description: Visualize how your metrics evolve over time with interactive charts.

feature3.title: Period Comparison
feature3.description: Compare current performance with previous periods to identify trends.

feature4.title: ABC Analysis
feature4.description: Classify products by importance using ABC curve for revenue, profit and volume.

feature5.title: Module Grid
feature5.description: Quick access to all system modules from the centralized control panel.

feature6.title: Data Export
feature6.description: Export reports in various formats for external analysis or presentations.

faq1.question: How many days of history are available?
faq1.answer: Paid plans include up to 12 months of retroactive history. The trial period includes data available at the time of connection.

faq2.question: Can I create custom dashboards?
faq2.answer: The system offers pre-configured dashboards optimized for Mercado Libre sellers. Customizations are on the roadmap.

faq3.question: Does data include all my accounts?
faq3.answer: Yes, dashboards consolidate data from all Mercado Libre accounts connected to your panel.

precificacao_custos.title: Pricing & Costs
precificacao_custos.subtitle: Price simulator, automatic Mercado Libre commission calculation, profit margin and break-even point per product.

feature1.title: Price Simulator
feature1.description: Simulate different price scenarios and see the impact on profit margin in real time.

feature2.title: Commission Calculator
feature2.description: Automatically calculate Mercado Libre commissions by category and listing type.

feature3.title: Profit Margin
feature3.description: View the real margin of each product considering cost, shipping, commissions and taxes.

feature4.title: Break-even Point
feature4.description: Discover the minimum price to cover all costs and start making profit.

feature5.title: Operational Costs
feature5.description: Record fixed and variable costs for a complete view of profitability.

feature6.title: Updated Commission Table
feature6.description: Access the always-updated Mercado Libre commission table by category.

faq1.question: Does the system consider shipping in calculations?
faq1.answer: Yes, the system considers shipping costs, commissions, taxes and operational costs in margin calculations.

faq2.question: Are commissions updated automatically?
faq2.answer: Yes, we keep the Mercado Libre commission table always synced with the latest updates.

faq3.question: Can I calculate costs for multiple products?
faq3.answer: Yes, you can calculate costs and margins for all your products at once.

radiografia_seed.title: X-Ray & Seed
radiografia_seed.subtitle: Deep listing analysis, health diagnosis and quality validation. Identify problems before they impact your sales.

feature1.title: Listing X-Ray
feature1.description: Complete analysis of any Mercado Libre listing with detailed quality scoring.

feature2.title: Health Diagnosis
feature2.description: Check the health of your listings with indicators for title, photos, description and attributes.

feature3.title: Quality Validation
feature3.description: Quality score that evaluates if your listing follows marketplace best practices.

feature4.title: Improvement Suggestions
feature4.description: Receive specific recommendations to improve the positioning of your listings.

feature5.title: Competitor Analysis
feature5.description: Compare your listings with competitors and identify improvement opportunities.

feature6.title: Continuous Monitoring
feature6.description: Track listing quality evolution over time with Seed monitoring tool.

faq1.question: Can I analyze competitor listings?
faq1.answer: Yes! X-Ray works with any public Mercado Libre listing, yours or competitors.

faq2.question: What is Seed?
faq2.answer: Seed is a continuous monitoring tool that tracks the health and performance of your listings over time.

faq3.question: Are analyses AI-powered?
faq3.answer: Yes, we use artificial intelligence to generate precise diagnostics and personalized improvement suggestions.

tendencias_concorrencia.title: Trends & Competition
tendencias_concorrencia.subtitle: Discover trending products, trending keywords and monitor competitor prices and strategies in real time.

feature1.title: Market Trends
feature1.description: Identify trending categories and products on Mercado Libre with updated data.

feature2.title: Trending Keywords
feature2.description: Discover the most searched and trending keywords to optimize your titles.

feature3.title: Price Monitoring
feature3.description: Track competitor prices and receive alerts for significant changes.

feature4.title: Competition Analysis
feature4.description: View the positioning of your products relative to direct competitors.

feature5.title: Niche Opportunities
feature5.description: Identify niches with high demand and low competition to expand your catalog.

feature6.title: Market Reports
feature6.description: Periodic reports with insights about market behavior in your category.

faq1.question: Where does trend data come from?
faq1.answer: Data is collected directly from official Mercado Libre APIs, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

faq2.question: Can I monitor specific categories?
faq2.answer: Yes, you can select categories of interest and receive updates about trends and competition.

faq3.question: How often is data updated?
faq3.answer: Trends and competition data is updated daily to ensure information is always relevant.

automacoes_alertas.title: Automations & Alerts
automacoes_alertas.subtitle: Automatic rules, smart notifications and task management. Automate your operation and never miss an important event.

feature1.title: Automation Rules
feature1.description: Create rules to adjust bids, pause listings or send alerts based on defined conditions.

feature2.title: Real-time Alerts
feature2.description: Receive notifications about critical events like sales drops, low stock or price changes.

feature3.title: Task Management
feature3.description: Integrated Kanban board to organize and track pending actions for your business.

feature4.title: Post-Sale Messages
feature4.description: Configure automatic messages to send to buyers after each sale.

feature5.title: Question Responses
feature5.description: Manage and respond to buyer questions in a centralized and agile way.

feature6.title: Promotion Management
feature6.description: Create and manage promotions for your products with dedicated tools.

faq1.question: Do automations execute actions on Mercado Libre?
faq1.answer: Currently, automations generate alerts and suggestions. Automatic action execution via ML API is on the roadmap.

faq2.question: Can I customize alert types?
faq2.answer: Yes, you can define which events generate alerts and the priority of each notification type.

faq3.question: Is the task board shared?
faq3.answer: Yes, in plans with multi-user support, the task board is shared among all team members.
